verdict.rationale: Meilisearch publishes an official MCP server integration (docs-13/17, probe-4) allowing agents to create indexes, add documents, and search via natural language prompts, and a runtime probe confirms the official meilisearch-mcp server completing a full keyless stdio JSON-RPC handshake. missing for 10: independent/community corroboration of real-world MCP usage beyond first-party docs and a single probe.
